summary.name: Intern (Shusheng / Shanghai AI Lab)
summary.one_liner: Intern is the open-source large model program from Shanghai AI Lab, presenting a timeline of InternLM, InternVL, Intern-S1 and related releases.
use_cases: Find open-source LLMs and multimodal models
Build or evaluate models with an open toolchain
Track release history of InternLM and InternVL
summary.what_it_does: The page is a chronological changelog of open-source model releases from the Intern series, dated from 2023 onward. It lists InternLM language models (7B, 20B, InternLM2, InternLM2.5 with 1M-token context, InternLM3-8B-Instruct), InternVL multimodal models (up to InternVL3.5 with 1B–241B variants), and Intern-S1 science models. It also mentions MindSearch (a multi-agent AI search engine), InternThinker reasoning models, and InternBootCamp. A section describes a standardized open-source toolchain covering pre-training through evaluation.
notable: InternLM-7B was made available for free commercial use
InternVL3.5 variants range from 1B to 241B parameters
Intern-S1 and Intern-S2 target science tasks such as molecular design and crystal structure generation
caveats: The page is a release timeline and does not describe pricing or licensing beyond the InternLM-7B commercial-use note
Page does not state hardware requirements or how to run the models
